createDescription: A flag starts off. Give it a stable machine key — lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
deleteDescription: This removes the flag and its per-user overrides. This cannot be undone.
description: Turn platform features on and off, globally or for one user.
noFlags: No feature flags yet. Create the first one.
noPermission: You do not have permission to manage feature flags.
overrideNone: No per-user overrides for this flag.
overrideSearchPlaceholder: Search users by name or email
overridesDescription: An override wins over the global switch for that user. Remove it and the global switch applies again.
phase8Note: Two features read flags: ai-spam-rescore guards submission re-scoring and ai-digest guards the digest job. An unknown or disabled flag keeps its job off.
reasonPlaceholder: Why are you changing this flag?
title: Feature flags
toggleDisableDescription: Turn this flag off for every user without a per-user override.
toggleEnableDescription: Turn this flag on for every user without a per-user override.
